title: Inspect additional context transfer candidates
changes: Identify three additional conditional halfword transfer source ranges from retained original caller disassembly and compare them with E135 ownership.
validation: Read-only decoding of three retained Thumb call pairs resolves each to the previously classified 000ad0 DMA queue helper; source literals and lengths imply 11744, 2048 and 2048 bytes.
Read-only E135 manifest join finds no declared source overlap for the three ranges; disassembly and manifest hashes are recorded in the feature guide. No guest execution or new tests ran.
limitations: The ranges are static candidates only: original source-byte authentication, live destinations, additional aliases, managed consumption and ordinary reachability remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements.
